reference: Exit 3: the jwt policy cannot verify tokens in staging (no JWKS URL, issuer or audience; the chart's empty values override the Secret). Set `env.AUTH_JWT_JWKS_URL`, `env.AUTH_JWT_ISSUER` and `env.AUTH_JWT_AUDIENCE` in values-staging.yaml (staging's identity provider must not reach prod through values.yaml), then `graph-agents-cli deploy --env staging --dry-run` passes.
